notes.title: Update 1.09
notes.notes: The game year now advances correctly in the spring, rather than the autumn.

notes.title: Update 1.08
notes.notes: Added a "Supporters" page to thank our major Kickstarter supporters.  Minor bugfixes.

notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.notes:
French AI no longer freezes in End Turn.

Place info box no longer appears when menus are open.

"Resume AI" button now animates in order to make it more clear that the AI is paused.

notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.notes:
To better match historical deployment, added regular units La Reine to Louisbourg and 48th Foot to Alexandria.  Moved Berry 1 and 49th Foot to the Force Pool.

Minor UI improvements.

notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.notes:
Can no longer build forts on the sealift counter

AI should no longer get paused by accident

AI should no longer appear to skip reinforcements phase

Improvements to UI deployment animations

Unit changes to match historical deployment; note that some units can't move the first turn

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.notes:
Online stability improvements.

New sieges no longer count as battles in battle selection.

Siege reports correctly display attacker rolls and location of siege.

Pinned units can now move in later phases.

Indigenous units can no longer move by themselves.

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.notes:
Cities no longer vanish when loading a game after starting a game.

New Sieges no longer count as battles.

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.notes:
Improved controller and Steam Deck interaction with units lists.

Clarified a rule for British Strategic Movement: units now can only deploy this way if the Sealift is located at a friendly place.

British 49th Foot unit now has a custom image.

notes.title: Release of PC game version
notes.notes:
[h2]Game Release[/h2]
After a good Beta testing campaign (thanks to our backers who helped us here, in particular Gary), the game will release today 21st November afternoon.

The game is playable on PC only for now, but you can use the Steamdeck to play it (this is a necessary step for the console version later). It is also playable in Multiplayer mode with your friends. The demo is updated, and all our Kickstarter backers and Beta testers who have supported us and received their Steam keys already can use them.

[b]Mac Version[/b]
The MacOS version will come later, as we are gathering now the necessary hardware to make the proper tests before release

[b]Future Developments[/b]
Steam achievements will also come later, as part of the continual improvement process to the game, as well as other elements (more scenarios, extra features, AI tweaks, etc...)

[h3]Demo[/h3]
To try the demo, go there: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811000/Small_Wars_Mohicans/


[h3]Crowdfunding[/h3]
To see more details on the game’s Kickstarter campaign, you can visit that page: 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/smallwarsmohicans/small-wars-mohicans]Kickstarter Campaign[/url]


[h3]Information on the Game[/h3]
All news and info that can come later about the game will be posted here on Steam, on the Kickstarter page, and, of course, on the game’s website here:

[url=https://www.smallwars-game.com/]Game Website[/url]
